name: Bolte Bridge
facts: Bolte Bridge, a twin cantilever marvel, stretches 490 metres yet feels longer, forming part of a five-kilometre elevated roadway linking Flemington Road to the West Gate Freeway.
Designed by Denton Corker Marshall and built by Baulderstone Hornibrook, construction spanned 1996‑1999, making it the largest balanced cantilever cast‑in‑situ box girder bridge in Australia.
Two 140‑metre high silver towers punctuate the span, originally a hotspot for urban explorers before being sealed, showcasing the bridge’s distinctive aesthetic flair.
